GetListing.name: GetListing
GetListing.documentation: Provides details about a listing, such as descriptions, badges, categories, pricing model summaries, reviews, and associated products and offers.

GetOffer.name: GetOffer
GetOffer.documentation: Provides details about an offer, such as the pricing model, seller of record, availability dates, badges, and associated products.

GetOfferSet.name: GetOfferSet
GetOfferSet.documentation: Provides details about an offer set, which is a bundle of offers across multiple products. Includes the seller, availability dates, buyer notes, and associated product-offer pairs.

GetOfferTerms.name: GetOfferTerms
GetOfferTerms.documentation: Retrieves the terms attached to an offer, such as pricing terms (usage-based, contract, Bring Your Own License (BYOL), free trial), legal terms, payment schedules, validity terms, support terms, and renewal terms. The operation returns results in pages. Use nextToken to retrieve the next page.

GetProduct.name: GetProduct
GetProduct.documentation: Provides details about a product, such as descriptions, highlights, categories, fulfillment option summaries, promotional media, and seller engagement options.

ListFulfillmentOptions.name: ListFulfillmentOptions
ListFulfillmentOptions.documentation: Retrieves the fulfillment options available for a product, including deployment details such as version information, operating systems, usage instructions, and release notes. The operation returns results in pages. Use nextToken to retrieve the next page.

ListListingAttributes.name: ListListingAttributes
ListListingAttributes.documentation: Retrieves the requested attributes for a listing, including case studies and trust center information. The operation returns results in pages. Use nextToken to retrieve the next page.

ListPurchaseOptions.name: ListPurchaseOptions
ListPurchaseOptions.documentation:
Retrieves the purchase options (offers and offer sets) available to you. You can filter results by product, seller, purchase option type, visibility scope, and availability status. The operation returns results in pages. Use nextToken to retrieve the next page.

You must include at least one of the following filters in the request: a PRODUCT_ID filter to specify the product for which to retrieve purchase options, or a VISIBILITY_SCOPE filter to retrieve purchase options by visibility.

SearchFacets.name: SearchFacets
SearchFacets.documentation: Retrieves the available facet values for filtering listings, such as categories, pricing models, fulfillment option types, publishers, and customer ratings. Each facet value includes a count of matching listings.

SearchListings.name: SearchListings
SearchListings.documentation: Searches for listings that match your search criteria and filters. You can search by keyword, filter by category, pricing model, fulfillment type, and other attributes, and sort results by relevance or customer rating. The operation returns results in pages. Use nextToken to retrieve the next page.

Locale.documentation:
A Best Current Practice 47 (BCP 47) language tag or comma-separated priority list of language tags that specifies the preferred locale for response content. The field accepts a maximum of two language tags.

The service resolves a locale string to the nearest supported locale. If no supported locale matches, the service applies the fallback behavior described in the following lists.

  • Preferred locale (first tag) – The locale you want the service to return content in.

  • Fallback locale (optional, second tag) – The service default locale (en-US or en). The service returns content in this locale when translated content for the preferred locale is unavailable.

The field is optional. If you omit this field or set it to null, the service returns content in the default locale (en-US).

The service supports the following locales:

en-US

English (service default, also resolves from en)

fr

French

es

Spanish

ko

Korean

ja

Japanese

The fallback behavior is as follows:

  • If translated content for the preferred locale is unavailable, the service returns content in the default locale.

  • If the preferred locale is not supported and you provide no fallback, the service returns a ValidationException.

  • If you provide an unsupported locale with the default locale as fallback (for example, xx, en-US), the service returns content in the default locale.

The locale field in Get API responses indicates the locale of the returned content. You can use this field to determine whether the response contains content in the requested locale or the default locale.

The following examples show how the field works:

fr

Request French content. If unavailable, falls back to en-US.

fr, en-US

Request French content with explicit fallback to English.

en-US

Request content in the default locale.

filterValues.documentation:
The values to filter by. Term filters accept multiple values, and a result matches if it has any of them. Range filters accept a single value. The supported values for each filterType are as follows:

CATEGORY

One or more category identifiers. Matches listings in those categories.

CERTIFICATES

One or more certification identifiers, such as ISO_27001 or SOC2_TYPE_2. Matches listings that hold those certifications.

DEPLOYED_ON_AWS

The single value DEPLOYED_ON_AWS. Matches listings whose products are deployed on AWS infrastructure.

FULFILLMENT_OPTION_TYPE

One or more fulfillment option types, such as SAAS, AMAZON_MACHINE_IMAGE, or CONTAINER. Matches listings that you can deploy or access in those ways.

MAX_AVERAGE_CUSTOMER_RATING

A single rating between 0.0 and 5.0. Matches listings whose average customer rating is at or below that value.

MIN_AVERAGE_CUSTOMER_RATING

A single rating between 0.0 and 5.0. Matches listings whose average customer rating is at or above that value.

NUMBER_OF_PRODUCTS

SINGLE_PRODUCT or MULTI_PRODUCT. Matches single-product listings or multi-product solutions.

PRICING_MODEL

One or more of BYOL, CONTRACT, FREE, and USAGE. Matches listings with offers that use those pricing models.

PRICING_UNIT

One or more pricing units, such as USERS, HOSTS, or REQUESTS. Matches listings that bill by those units.

PRODUCT_ID

One or more product identifiers. Matches listings that contain those products.

PUBLISHER

One or more publisher identifiers. Matches listings from those sellers.

SELLER_ENGAGEMENT

One or more SellerEngagementType values, such as BUY_NOW or REQUEST_FOR_DEMO. Matches listings that offer those ways to engage with the seller.

SPECIALIZATION

One or more specialization identifiers. Matches listings that earned those specializations.

SPECIALIZATION_CATEGORY

One or more specialization category identifiers. Matches listings that earned a category under a specialization.

TRUST_CENTER

The single value HAS_TRUST_CENTER. Matches listings that have a trust center.

Use SearchFacets to retrieve the values available for CATEGORY, PUBLISHER, CERTIFICATES, SPECIALIZATION, and SPECIALIZATION_CATEGORY.

reason.documentation:
The reason that the input fails to satisfy the constraints that the Discovery API specifies. This field has one of the following values:

INVALID_PAGINATION_TOKEN

The nextToken value is malformed, expired, or belongs to a different request. Start the pagination again from the first page.

MALFORMED_REQUEST_PARAMETERS

One or more request parameters have an invalid value. Correct the parameters that you specified, and then resubmit your request.

PAGINATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED

The request asks for results beyond the deepest page that the operation returns. Narrow your request with filters or a more specific search.

ValidationException.documentation: The input fails to satisfy the constraints specified by the service. Check the reason field for the constraint that failed.

documentation: With the AWS Marketplace Discovery API (Discovery API), you have programmatic access to the AWS Marketplace catalog. You can search and browse listings, retrieve product details and fulfillment options, and access public and private offer pricing and terms. For more information, see Using the AWS Marketplace Discovery API in the AWS Marketplace Developer Guide.
